title: daphne pampaninii
intro: Daphne pampaninii, commonly known as Himalayan daphne or Indian daphne, is a flowering plant species native to the Himalayan region. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Daphne pampaninii include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include daphnin, a lignan with potential therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
